mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.node_order, n.node_name, n.approver_type, n.approver_id, COALESCE(r.name, u.nickname) AS approver_name, n.condition_expr, n.create_time FROM wf_node n LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON n.approver_type = 'APPROVER' AND r.id = n.approver_id AND r.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.approver_type = 'USER' AND u.id = n.approver_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE n.definition_id = #{definitionId} AND n.deleted = 0 ORDER BY n.node_order
